notes.title: The Sovereign's Ascent
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852188/60ef977501e91dd8f25b6846c8d848d6a7fdbdbc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]National Tier[/b][/p][p]Added the [b]\[National Tier][/b] mechanism for all factions. The National Tier is a metric used to control the overall development level of a player's faction. As a match progresses, players can raise their National Tier through a series of [b]proactive actions[/b]. The National Tier determines the upgrade caps for a player's technology and buildings. At the start of a match, both opposing sides begin at National Tier 1. If a player meets certain conditions during the game, they can spend a large amount of resources and time to elevate their National Tier. This process is called a National Reform. Players can choose a direction in which to advance their nation's tier. Upon completion of the National Reform, the player's faction will receive significant bonuses related to the chosen direction. The National Tier can only be increased, not decreased. It is only effective for the current match and is not carried over. There are three National Tiers in total: Vassal, Kingdom, and Empire.[/p][p]The National Tier will have the following effects:[/p][p][b]Technology[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each technology has a "Required National Tier for Research." Therefore, the National Tier determines the maximum level of technological development for a faction.[/p][/*][*][p]Researching a technology requires meeting its corresponding National Tier prerequisite. If the current National Tier does not meet the requirement for a technology, it cannot enter the research state.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Buildings[/b][/p][list][*][p]The National Tier determines the maximum upgrade level for a faction's buildings. Before reaching the maximum number of building upgrades allowed for the current tier, players can freely upgrade any upgrade item for any building. Once the limit is reached, the player cannot upgrade any item for any building. The upgrade count is registered when the player initiates the upgrade action, not upon its completion.[/p][/*][*][p]After a player completes a new National Reform and raises their National Tier, they can upgrade new building items until they once again reach the maximum building upgrade limit for the new tier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vassal Tier:[/b] Building upgrades are not allowed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kingdom Tier:[/b] A maximum of 50% of upgrade items for each building can be completed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Empire Tier:[/b] All upgrade items for buildings can be completed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Policies[/b][/p][list][*][p]The National Tier determines a faction's number of policy slots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vassal Tier:[/b] Initial number of policy slots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kingdom Tier:[/b] +4 policy slots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Empire Tier:[/b] +6 additional policy slots (for a cumulative total of +10).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Taxation[/b][/p][list][*][p]The National Tier determines a faction's tax efficiency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vassal Tier:[/b] Initial tax efficiency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kingdom Tier:[/b] +30% tax income.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Empire Tier:[/b] +40% additional tax income (for a cumulative total of +70%).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Base Towers[/b][/p][list][*][p]The National Tier determines the stats of a faction's Base Towers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vassal Tier:[/b] Initial Base Tower stats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kingdom Tier:[/b] Base Tower Attack +25%, Range +5%, Defense +10%, HP +30%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Empire Tier:[/b] Base Tower Attack +45%, Range +5%, Defense +10%, HP +30% (Cumulative bonuses for Base Tower: Attack +70%, Range +10%, Defense +20%, HP +60%).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]New Map Variant[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added the [b]\[Explorer][/b] map, which has no Fog of War. The original version with Fog of War has been renamed to [b]\[Explorer (Fog)][/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Building[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added the new building [b]\[Rally Point][/b], which can be used as a unit spawn point.[/p][/*][*][p]Exclusive to [b]\[France][/b] and [b]\[France - L'État, c'est moi][/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]\[France][/b] can obtain it through the Kingdom upgrade [b]\[Ordonnance Gendarmes][/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[France - L'État, c'est moi][/b] can obtain it through the Kingdom upgrade [b]\[Armagnacs][/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]UI Optimizations[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]\[New][/b] Players can now click the upgrade button again while a building is upgrading to cancel the upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Added icons for game terms such as Attack, Defense, and HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Added icons for unit categories (e.g., Melee Infantry, Archers & Crossbowmen, Cavalry).[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the layout of the match setup screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Redrew the vast majority of technology tree icons.[/p][/*][*][p]When resources or administration points are gained, a corresponding icon will now float above the relevant unit on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]When a unit is low on supply, a corresponding icon will now float above its head.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the display duration for certain notifications in the bottom-right information panel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Removals[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Removed the function to upgrade the [b]\[Base Tower][/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the function to exchange administration points for policy slots.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Increased the cost of all unit types.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the work speed of workers gathering Food and Gold. In their initial state, workers now gather and drop off Food at 3 times the speed of gathering and dropping off Gold. Workers drop off resources at a Warehouse at 3 times the speed of dropping off at the home base; this is reduced to 2 times the speed when the Warehouse is fully upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the initial Food carrying capacity of workers.[/p][/*][*][p]The bonus from the [b]\[Quality][/b] upgrade in the [b]\[Barracks][/b] has been increased by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]The bonuses from the [b]\[Blacksmith][/b] have been doubled.[/p][/*][*][p]On the [b]\[Mt.Mafang][/b], [b]\[Explorer][/b], and [b]\[Explorer (Fog)][/b] maps, the cost to recruit villages is increased by 33% if the player is in the [b]\[Vassal][/b] stage, and decreased by 33% if the player is in the [b]\[Empire][/b] stage.[/p][/*][*][p]For [b]\[Ming - Court Factions][/b], the number of official slots can no longer be actively upgraded and is now tied to the National Tier.[/p][/*][*][p]For [b]\[Ming - Court Factions][/b], the condition for a faction to become dominant has been lowered to requiring the number of same-faction members to exceed half of the maximum cabinet official slots. The trigger conditions for edicts have also been lowered.[/p][/*][*][p]The completion condition for the [b]\[Bosphorus Trade Route][/b] for [b]\[Byzantium - Phoenix of the Purple Eagle][/b] has been changed to: Reach the Empire National Tier.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]\[Heated Shot][/b] upgrade for the [b]\[Fortress][/b] had no effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain UI detail panels would remain on screen indefinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where workers would be lost if placed simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some audio would continue playing after exiting a match.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Cristoforo Colombo
notes.content: [h2][b]New Map:  \[Explorer][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852188/b826040df75b98425923fd92d38540eb2cab3f04.png"][/img][/p][p]A brand-new [b]randomly generated map[/b] with [b][i]fog of war[/i][/b] has been added![/p][list][*][p]Each time you start the game, roads will be procedurally generated. They might be straight, winding, or even layered like overpasses—be prepared to navigate a true [i]maze[/i]![/p][/*][*][p]Resources and villages will also be randomly placed. Keep an eye on depleted resource points and make sure to relocate and protect your workers! Of course, this also means you can launch surprise attacks on your enemy’s economy at any time![/p][/*][*][p]Now, you can [b]ONLY[/b] see areas near your own units, buildings, or villages. Areas shrouded in fog will conceal all enemy movement and construction—so always be alert for enemies emerging from the shadows! A clever commander, however, can use this to their advantage to stage a surprise attack![/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2][p][b]Updated Unit Physics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spearmen and cavalry now deal more effective knockback to enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjusted Ranged Unit Ballistics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Archers can now fire in a realistic arcing trajectory.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: L'État, c'est moi
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852188/9b64654941c08a4be3a68df97a19f875135d539c.jpg[/img]

[h1]
L'État, c'est moi
[/h1]
Update of Version 0.190.1.0

[list]
[h2][*][b]Three newly derived forces[/b] have come[/h2]
[olist]
[*][b]Ming Dynasty - Factional Court[/b]
It's the Ming Dynasty with the [b]【Cabinet】[/b] mechanism. As the emperor of the Ming Dynasty, you will encounter all kinds of officials in the cabinet. You have to try every means to make them work for you and also make them check and balance each other. If the whole court can work together with one heart, then your country will surely endure for thousands of years. [/*]
[*][b]France - L'État, c'est moi[/b]
It's France with the [b]【Estates General】[/b] mechanism. As the king of France, you have to "elegantly" win over and suppress the three estates. Different attitudes towards the three estates will bring you different considerable benefits, yet overexploiting will also lead to bad consequences. However, no one in the France can say no to you. You are the kingdom itself! [/*]
[*][b]Byzantium - The Purple Eagle Rising from the Ashes[/b]
It's Byzantium with the [b]【Reviving the Roman Empire】[/b] mechanism. As the Basileus of Byzantium, you can improve the prestige of the empire by completing a series of tasks. Different levels of imperial prestige will bring different bonuses to your empire, and you can also choose to spend this prestige to obtain other effects. The emperor of the Romans will return like lightning and lead the double-headed eagle to be reborn from the ashes! [/*]
[/olist]
[h2][*]Mechanism Adjustments[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Units fighting near their own buildings will receive attack and defense bonuses. If they are watchtowers, fortresses, fences or stone walls, the bonuses will be even greater. [/*]
[*]Now when the Mongols demolish buildings and then rebuild them, they will inherit the original upgrades. Buildings purchased by the Mongols with the Sulde will be automatically fully upgraded after being built. [/*]
[*]The calculation mechanism of productivity has been adjusted. [/*]
[*]The building costs have been increased. [/*]
[*]The costs of obtaining policies, gold and policy slots through administrative points have been increased. The acquisition efficiency of administrative points has been reduced. [/*]
[*]The effect of the [b]【Academy】[/b] has been modified to: accelerate the research and development of technology and simultaneously slowly generate administrative points. [/*]
[*]Some other balance adjustments have been made. [/*]
[/olist]
[h2][*]Optimizations[/h2]
[olist]
[*]UI dynamic effects have been added. [/*]
[*]The building UI has been modified. Now the building window has been moved to the lower half of the window, and by long-pressing the upgrade items, you can view the specific bonuses. [/*]
[*]Performance optimization has been carried out, significantly increasing the frame rate. [/*]
[*]Special effects have been added for building upgrades, building construction, the increase in village loyalty, units entering the battlefield, buildings being attacked, victory or defeat, cavalry charges and so on. [/*]
[*]Cloud shadow effects have been added to the [b]【Ma Fang Shan】[/b] map (visible in medium quality and above). [/*]
[/olist]
[h2][*]BUG Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*]The BUG that the price became zero when quickly purchasing villages has been fixed. [/*]
[*]The BUG of incorrect productivity calculation has been fixed. [/*]
[*]The BUG that there was no count of destroyed buildings in the post-game statistics has been fixed. [/]
[*]The BUG of some UI layout errors has been fixed. [/*]
[*]The BUG that some characters could not be displayed correctly has been fixed. [/*]
[*]Some other BUGs have been fixed. [/*]
[/olist]
[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: the Mongol Empire launches its conquest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852188/ef62d6e2acc40f706417ba31956b722ab3760d56.png[/img]

[h1]1. [New] The Mongol Empire is coming! [/h1]
[h2]【Unique effect】[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Dedicate a fief] Every time a village is occupied, the number of cavalry reserves +2, the cavalry production speed +10%, and the cavalry supply -10%.
[*] [Thousand Household System] The productivity provided by the cavalry is +20%, and the cavalry production speed is +30%.
[*] [Nomad] It takes a certain amount of time to demolish a building. After demolishing it, you can build an identical building for free (excluding building upgrades).
[*] [Tradition of Cavalry and Archery] Cavalry speed +20%, attack power +20%, health +20%. Cavalry speed +10%, attack power +10%.
[*] [Plunder] starts with the policy [Sweep], but the cost of administrative points to obtain the policy is +30%.
[/list]
[h2]【Unique troops】[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Nomad Cavalry] An extremely cheap cavalry with lower combat effectiveness than ordinary cavalry.
[*] [Batu] A light cavalry that replaces the light cavalry and is faster and has higher attack power. If a unit is killed before the next resupply, no food will be consumed during the next resupply.
[*] [Daorhan] Replaces heavy cavalry and is a faster heavy cavalry.
[*] [Kheshig] Instead of cavalry archer, Kheshig will automatically maintain the distance from the current shooting target as the shooting distance.
[*] [Khan] The combat mechanism is the same as that of Qie Xue. At the same time, it provides attack power and speed bonus to surrounding units.
[*] [Great Khan of Mongolia] Replaces the Khan with greater attack power, health, and range of action.
[*] [Qian Jun] Infantry unit has the same combat effectiveness as the militia, but has more reserves and consumes more supplies.
[*] [Russian Prince Soldiers] An infantry unit that replaces the Signing Army and is only produced by the Golden Horde. It is slightly stronger than the Signing Army.
[*] [Hui Hui Pao(gravity trebuchet)] A long-range siege unit. Cheaper than artillery, takes less time to train, moves faster, but takes longer to fire.
[/list]
[h2]【Unique system】[/h2]
You can get 1 Sulu Bar for every 4 units you kill, and you can also get Sulu Bars by researching some technologies, which can be used to buy soldiers or buildings.
Purchase items are refreshed every 30 seconds, with a maximum of three appearing at a time.
Spending Sulu ingots can also be used to establish [Dayuan] [Chagatai Khanate] [Golden Horde] and [Ilkhanate]. You can only choose one to establish in a game. Different countries will have different upgrade options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852188/4fdf6215700412294b7099f3cb14241b1641cdaa.png[/img]
[h2]【Unique policy】[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Daruka Chi] Units around the Khan or the Mongol Khan can provide 50% productivity
[*] [National Privilege] Tax efficiency +20%, worker productivity -30%.
[*] [Reign of Restraint] The village can slowly produce gold additionally, but the efficiency of exerting influence is -30%.
[/list]

[h1]2. [New] Outpost and Bastille[/h1]
Whiteboard, Ming Dynasty, France, and Byzantium allow the construction of [Outpost] at the beginning, which can shoot arrows at enemy units that enter attack range.
The original Garrison Point has now been replaced by the Bastille, a more powerful Outpost that can be upgraded to a turret.

[h1]3. [New] Tutorial[/h1]
A new tutorial system has been added. You will be prompted to open it when you start the game for the first time. You can also enter it under the "Tutorial" button on the main interface later.

[h1]4. 【New】Console[/h1]
You can open the console in the settings interface and use cheat codes in single-player mode:
